patch_list: Stops the trackers: AdShift install attribution, TikTok event reporting, Gemius audience measurement, Microsoft Clarity session recording, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, and Facebook's automatic app events. Your lists, sy…
Stops the pop-ups and banners that Listonic sends to the app as marketing campaigns (Firebase In-App Messaging). Push notifications and the app's own messages stay.

Makes signing in with Google and push notifications work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by its maker. Needs MicroG-RE install…

Hides the banners, ads between list items and full-screen ads, and doesn't start the ad networks (AppLovin, Google, AdAdapted, Smart and their partners) when the app opens, or ask for ad consent. The ads you choose to watch for Broccoli co…
Hides the Assistant's suggestions (such as "Suggest missing products" and "Quick dinner idea") below your lists. The Assistant itself stays.
Hides the Broccoli coins button in the top bars and the Broccoli coins card on the profile screen, for when you don't collect coins for ads. Coins you have stay in your account.
Hides the Food facts tab that shows up in the bottom bar.
Hides the shop leaflets and partner offers (Offerista) shown on the lists screen and inside your lists. The offers and leaflets you open yourself stay.

Hides the "Buy premium" button in the lists screen's top bar, the "Remove ads, Upgrade now!" card and the "Discover Premium benefits" section on the profile screen, and the PREMIUM section of the settings. A subscription is managed in Goog…

Hides the Premium offers that show up by themselves: the sale campaigns (such as "Black Friday sale! -50%") on the lists screen and the Premium offer that opens after the first start. Premium itself, its features and the offers you open yo…
Hides what asks you to rate the app on Google Play: the prompt after a while of use, the "Love Listonic?" card on the profile screen and the "Enjoying the app?" row below it.
Stops the Google Play update-available and forced-update screens. Google Play can't update a patched app; update it by patching the new version.
Removes the location permissions. Listonic uses your location only for shops and offers near you; without them it can't ask for your location.
